dosage_and_administration: Directions Apply liberally 15 minutes before sun exposure. Reapply at least every 2 hours. Use a water-resistant sunscreen if swimming or sweating. Spending time in the sun increases your risk of skin cancer and early skin aging. Children under 6 months of age: ask a doctor.
